strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. Gran Garan destroyed 2. Nadesico Y Unit destroyed
Nie Givun... Is this... the surface world?
So it would seem, Lady Sheela.
Huh~, it's not that different from Byston Well~.
Surface world, surface world~!
Is this really the surface world? But... why so suddenly!?
...I don't know. But if the light that engulfed Show and the others...
the thing that swept us in, was the Aura Road...
then this is definitely the surface world.
Holy Warrior Show Zama... What on earth is happening up here...?
Ah! Lady Sheela! Nie!
It can't be...!
Drake's army is up here too!?
...Is this really the surface world!?
Yeah, no doubt about it. Looks like Japan, though...
Never thought I'd end up back up here!
Allen Brady...!
No business with small fry! Bring out the Holy Warrior, Show Zama!
Show Zama is not here. You... said you were Allen Brady.
...Answer me. Has Drake's army... all come up to the surface too...!?
Wouldn't know! Not about anyone but my unit! But...
Both you and we... were swallowed by that strange light and came here...
The others are probably here too! But this place is mine!
Don't mess with us! Nie, Keen, let 'em have it!
Let 'em have it~!
Keen! We'll protect Lady Sheela and hold out as long as we can!
Ngh, but against this many...!
Found 'em! It's the Gran Garan!
Lady Sheela!
Lady Sheela! That's...!!
Could it be... Holy Warrior Show Zama...!?
Show!?
Looks like rushing over was the right call.
Marvel's here too!?
The Nadesico, the surface military's ship, had trouble, so we went ahead.
Heh, Show ain't the only Holy Warrior around.
Even Todd Guinness...
Do they mean to spread Byston Well's war even to the surface...?
Show! You found us that quickly!?
Aura Battlers... and even Aura Ships are appearing all over the surface!
We came to the nearest Aura Ship reading... Glad we made it in time.
I see... I wish to believe Aura Power guided the Holy Warrior here.
But that nasty eyebrow guy's here too!
Heh, what're you all yapping about!? Show Zama!
It won't go like last time!
Show Zama, what is the surface military doing?
Lady Sheela! We'll talk later! Let's go, Nie, Keen, Marvel!
Right, we'll stop them no matter what!
Hang in there, Show!
If we hit them before they regroup...!
...Brace yourself, Holy Warrior!
Waaaugh! No way... Me!?
This is the end! Jeryl Kuchibi!
...!! This Aura Power!? No, Show Zama!
Aaaaaaaah!
Don't you underestimate meeeeee!!
Did I get her!?
Show! Did you do it!? Did you beat her!?
After all this! After all this, why can't I win!? Show Zamaaa! I'm...!
Ooooh! Me...? It can't be! Why!?
It's over! Allen!
Why!? Why am I being beaten so easily...!
Unlucky bastard... Go join Fei in the afterlife! Allen!
Jeryl, you...!
You'd laugh at your own comrade...!
You lose 'cause you're weak!
Why!? Why can't I be like Jeryl!? If I had that power too...!
That's a power no human should have, Allen!
Uoooooh!
Guess... I'm finally running out of breath...!
Nie! Don't lose heart!
Show, Marvel... When the moment is right, withdraw from this airspace.
...Lady Sheela!?
You must understand, Holy Warrior Show Zama.
Why we have surfaced, and what is about to happen
to the surface and to Byston Well...
What? What're you talking about!? Lady Sheela!?
And that Drake and his forces... were simply swept up in it as well.
Isn't it because there's too much Aura Power!?
...Something much bigger is in motion...!
Lost your nerve!? If you won't come, I'm coming to you!
Show! Look!
Looks like we made it in time!
Look, Big Bro, there's Aura Battlers swarming all over!
We have to hurry!
We managed to get here, but... Ruri, can the Nadesico's trouble be fixed?
I'm still working on Omoikane, but... it's no good.
If anything, it's getting worse.
Aww, no good here either. The helm won't respond.
The Nadesico is stopping at its current position.
Hey, hey, are we gonna be okay like this?
It's a learning computer problem... It won't be easy to fix...
There must be some underlying cause... If we had time to look into it.
It can't be helped... Captain.
Aestivalis team, sortie! Please provide close cover for the Nadesico!
Seriously, what is going on?
Can't be helped. I, Gai Daigoji, will protect you!
Guys like that are always the first to fall, y'know~.
Laugh here, 100 yen... What a cheap fall.
Hey! Don't you guys stray too far from the Nadesico!
Good grief.
Everyone, please be careful...
Tch, I dawdled too long!
Show! Everyone came for us!
Everyone!
Show, Big Bro! You're safe now!
Geez... You're late, cavalry!
The Nadesico's been acting up! ...I'll make up for being late!
Aura Battlers, huh... We'll have to fight smart!
Yeah, get thrown off by their moves and you'll get hurt bad. Stay sharp.
We can move just as well as they can!
It's fine that you won't lose, but don't forget the Nadesico can't move.
That's right. ...We'll just have to draw the enemy over to us.
Turned into a big fight all of a sudden. Heh... Now this is fun.
Hm... I sense pressure from one of them... Zama, that huge castle...
is it a battleship?
Captain Quattro! Lady Sheela is aboard it!
Lady... Sheela?
Captain, she's the queen of the other world Kamille and I were sent to
from Jaburo before... Byston Well.
We've met her. ...But why is she here!?
Sir Amuro Ray... Will you lend us your strength once again?
Of course, Queen Sheela.
We'll need to ask her how this happened, too.
There are some mechs I've seen before.
Last time it was Byston Well, now it's the surface world.
Anyway, let's beat those guys first!
Yeah, yeah, the enemy looks all fired up!
Hah, we pop out on the surface... and snag some big prey!
The Aura Battler...!?
Hmph, Jeryl, huh.
Jeryl...!? Red-haired Jeryl Kuchibi!
That's the Gran Garan, all right... And the Holy Warrior Show Zama!
Looks like my luck's turning too.
Answer me! Drake... Has Drake come to the surface as well!?
Wouldn't know! And even if I did, I've no reason to tell you!
She seems like a nasty person too~.
It's less her personality... She's starting to drown in her Aura Power...
You're from the surface world, yet you want war here!?
Jeryl...!
You rotten woman!
Hmph! Then I'll knock you flat and see for myself!
That's how we've always pushed forward, isn't it?
In the end, all we can count on is ourselves!
Quit your squawking, you brats!
This creep pisses me off every time! I'm gonna knock you down a peg!
Looks like that mouth of hers isn't just empty bluster...
Careful! Their Aura Barriers give them strong defenses!
Indeed. ...Mobile suit weapons may struggle.
Then they'll learn the power of the Great...!
Don't underestimate Mazinger's power!
Tch, so we've gotta take 'em up close, huh?
Heh! I'll slice right through that barrier with the Danku Sword!
I'll show you Raideen's power!
Whatever they are... we'll shoot down every last one...!
Hahaha! Go ahead and try!
Jeryl!? What did you do!?
What is that...! The Leprechaun... This aura... Is that Jeryl...?
The Aura Battler...!?
Jeryl, what did you do!?
Stay out of this, Allen! Nobody... can stop me now!
The Leprechaun looks like it's gotten huge.
Am I seeing an illusion...!?
This... emotion... a light of terrible hatred...!
...What is this pressure... Big Bro?
Heh... Hahahahahaha!
Heheh... If my enemies look small... that means I'm gonna win!!
She's gone Hyper...!
Lady Sheela!?
Evil aura gone out of control...
No, that must not be left on the surface! Show Zama!
Even I can tell...! That's the light of human hatred...! We have to beat it!
Still, it's huge...! Hey, hey, this is no joke!
Doesn't look... like an illusion...
Masato, can't you figure anything out!?
That's the thing... it makes no sense. It's definitely there...
So it's no hallucination, but... I can't get a solid physical reading either.
Could it be Aura Power... made physical by Aura Power itself...?
Ruri, what's our analysis?
...Omoikane...!? What's wrong...!? Listen to me.
Ruri...?
Captain, we're in big trouble.
What's wrong? Did something happen?
Omoikane is...!
What the!? The Aestivalis!
Huh!?
What's going on!? The controls...!
What's going on!? The Nadesico won't do what I tell it!?
Omoikane hasn't shut down... it's refusing our commands.
Hey! Why is that happening!?
The Nadesico...!? What's wrong, Captain Misumaru!
The Nadesico and all units of the Aestivalis team... are out of control!
What!? What are you doing!? At a time like this!
Aww, please don't get mad! We don't know what's going on either!
Why'd the Nadesico and the Aestivalis suddenly stop moving!?
Captain Misumaru, what is going on!?
Yurika! Did you screw something up again!?
Ruriii! Everyone everywhere is chewing me out!
Please don't panic, Captain.
...Omoikane is ignoring our entire chain of command...
and is controlling the Nadesico and the Aestivalis.
Omoikane... That's the Nadesico's central computer, right?
That's right, Captain.
Put bluntly, the Nadesico has seized the Aestivalis controls too.
Hahahahahaha! Looks like you've got some kind of problem.
...Tough luck, Holy Warrior...! That's right, this is how a fight should be!
What's the point of a fight like this!
Who cares about the point! As long as it's fun!
Jeryl, you...!
Red-haired Jeryl Kuchibi...!
Show Zama! Today's the day, like they say!
I won't let you!
Hm!?
(This frightening power... What is it? Is someone watching us?)
Pay close attention to the giant Aura Battler! Intercept it!
What about the Nadesico!?
...Cover it! We can't let it fall here!
Jeryl...! The Nadesico can't move!? Damn!
Show! Here she comes!
It's gone... that enormous aura of malice.
Jeryl... So that was... an aura of malice...
Show...?
(The presence... is gone?)
...For a while there, I didn't know what would happen...
It's not all over yet. It's too early to relax, Kamille.
Exactly. ...The bad dream is over. Now to mop up the real enemies left.
(Three exceptional Newtypes, and none of them noticed... As I thought...)
Hm... Kyosuke?
No, it's nothing. ...I'll help mop up the enemy.
Hoshino, how is Omoikane?
...No change.
Aww, doesn't it get fixed once you beat the bad guys?
You watch too much TV.
Show...
Allen... The power of hatred... creates nothing.
Battle Mastery increased by 1.
It seems to be over...
Lady Sheela...? We won... Aren't you happy...?
Most of the enemy soldiers were people of Byston Well too...
How did it come to this...?
Ever since the surface man Shot Weapon built the Aura Machines...
it seems everything began to go wrong...
That's...
Surface folks... We're what you'd call surface folks too, but...
A surface man named Shot built robots in another world...
and the ones destroying them are surface people too... us.
...I do not mean to speak ill of you.
Thank you all... Allow me to express my gratitude once more...
No, you helped us before in Byston Well.
Please don't worry about it.
Looks like we managed to protect this ship, but...
You mean the Nadesico...
How is it, Ruri-Ruri?
No change.
So it can't fight at all, huh?
It seems this dock stay in Sasebo will take some time.
Then for our upcoming operations...
It can't come along. It was unstable to begin with,
and then it took the energy of that giant Aura Battler...
At this stage, there's too much we can't explain.
Probably... that's not all...
Ruri...?
And so... that's how things are.
Aw, don't sweat it. You were planning to stop at this dock anyway, right?
You make it sound so simple...
Without the Nadesico, Tenkawa and the rest can't move their machines.
Correct. ...Running Aestivalis on their own isn't very realistic.
Yeah, it was a real pain when we took out the Nanafushi too.
We finally reach the surface and lose a battleship right away...
Speaking of battleships... Lady Sheela, what will you do now?
...We will travel with you, Holy Warrior.
Huh? But...
Drake has surely come to the surface as well. That evil aura...
We cannot let the war of Byston Well spread any further on the surface.
Yes, you're right. Drake, at least, must be stopped...
Also... if we have surfaced, Lady Ele's Goraon must be somewhere too.
If so, we must join with her. In this world, we do not belong...
But shouldn't you take it easy?
No. From what I see, you have a great many units.
That waterfowl-like battleship alone would struggle to carry them all.
That's true... The Elshank alone might have a hard time.
...May we accept your kind offer?
Yes.
Heh, she gets it.
Kappei! Don't be rude!
Then, Queen Sheela, let us work together for peace in this land.
Yes... And you are? You do not seem to be from the surface...
nor from Byston Well, it seems...
My name is Romina Radorio.
...Let me tell you about that along the way.
I'm also interested in hearing about Byston Well.
Their conversation's... so elegant...
A princess's battleship and a queen's battleship, huh?
You don't see a unit like this very often.
Heh, till now we were a unit of grubby old guys.
Awww!
If the Nadesico could move, I could've joined the beautiful captains' fleet!
This is no time to be saying that! Besides, you're not even royalty!
Ugh... I have Akito, my prince...
Megumi, how's the docking paperwork?
We've been cleared to enter port.
And Akito is NOT your prince!
A-anyway, the Nadesico will be adjusted here for a while... Good luck.
Understood. We'll head for our next destination.
I suppose we should be grateful the Gran Garan is coming with us...
...Holy Warrior Show Zama. There is a unit I wish to give you.
A unit...? An Aura Battler!?
Yes. Built with all the technology of the land of Na...
the Aura Battler Billbine.
There is only one, but... it should serve you well.
All right, Show!
The Billbine, huh.
Hm... Kyosuke? What's wrong?
Nothing... I was wondering what that giant growth was...
Jeryl couldn't control her own Aura Power... and as a result...
Show... Could it happen to you too!?
(And what I sensed then... Aura Power... going Hyper...
How are they all connected?)
